<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ja">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no">
<title>FreePad</title>
<style>
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html,body{height:100%;overflow:hidden}
body{
  font-family:-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;
  background:#1c1c1e;color:#fff;
  width:100dvw;height:100dvh;
  touch-action:none;user-select:none;
}
.screen{position:fixed;inset:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.screen.hidden{display:none!important}

/* ===== SETUP ===== */
#setupScreen{background:#1c1c1e;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow-y:auto}
.setup-card{
  background:#2c2c2e;border-radius:20px;padding:36px 32px;
  width:min(480px,92vw);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:18px;margin:24px auto;
}
.setup-card h2{
  font-size:24px;font-weight:700;
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a78bfa,#60a5fa);
  -webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text
}
.setup-card p{font-size:13px;color:#8e8e93;line-height:1.6}
.setup-card label{font-size:13px;color:#aeaeb2;font-weight:600;display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
.setup-input{
  width:100%;padding:11px 14px;
  background:#1c1c1e;border:1.5px solid #3a3a3c;
  border-radius:10px;color:#fff;font-size:15px;outline:none;transition:border-color .2s;
  touch-action:auto;user-select:text;-webkit-user-select:text
}
.setup-input:focus{border-color:#7c3aed}
.setup-input::placeholder{color:#636366}
.btn-primary{
  background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7c3aed,#2563eb);
  color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:12px;
  padding:13px;font-size:16px;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer;
}
.btn-primary:active{opacity:.85}
.setup-error{color:#ff453a;font-size:13px;display:none;padding:8px 12px;background:rgba(255,69,58,.1);border-radius:8px}
.url-box{
  background:#1c1c1e;border:1.5px solid #3a3a3c;border-radius:10px;
  padding:10px 14px;font-size:12px;color:#8e8e93;word-break:break-all;line-height:1.6;display:none
}
.url-box strong{color:#a78bfa;display:block;margin-bottom:4px}
.btn-copy{background:#3a3a3c;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;align-self:flex-start;display:none}
.step-badge{background:rgba(124,58,237,.15);color:#a78bfa;border-radius:6px;padding:2px 8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:700;margin-right:6px}

/* ===== HOME ===== */
.home-header{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:16px 20px 12px;background:#2c2c2e;border-bottom:1px solid #3a3a3c;flex-shrink:0}
.home-header h1{font-size:26px;font-weight:700;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#a78bfa,#60a5fa);-webkit-background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;background-clip:text}
.header-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;align-items:center}
.btn-new{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7c3aed,#2563eb);color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:20px;padding:9px 16px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
.btn-settings{background:#3a3a3c;border:none;border-radius:50%;width:36px;height:36px;cursor:pointer;color:#fff;font-size:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.boards-grid{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;padding:16px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(170px,1fr));gap:14px;align-content:start;touch-action:pan-y}
.board-card{background:#2c2c2e;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s,box-shadow .2s;border:2px solid transparent;position:relative}
.board-card:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 8px 30px rgba(124,58,237,.35);border-color:#7c3aed}
.board-thumb{width:100%;aspect-ratio:4/3;background:#f5f4ef;display:block}
.board-info{padding:10px 12px}
.board-name{font-size:14px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;color:#f2f2f7}
.board-date{font-size:11px;color:#8e8e93;margin-top:2px}
.board-props{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px}
.prop-badge{font-size:10px;padding:2px 7px;border-radius:10px;background:rgba(124,58,237,.2);color:#a78bfa;white-space:nowrap}
.board-del{position:absolute;top:6px;right:6px;background:rgba(255,59,48,.9);border:none;border-radius:50%;width:28px;height:28px;color:#fff;font-size:14px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;opacity:0;transition:opacity .2s}
.board-card:hover .board-del{opacity:1}
.sync-status{font-size:12px;color:#8e8e93;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px}
.sync-dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#34c759}
.sync-dot.loading{background:#ff9500;animation:pulse 1s infinite}
.sync-dot.error{background:#ff453a}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.3}}
.empty-state{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;padding:60px 20px;color:#8e8e93}

/* ===== EDITOR ===== */
#editorScreen{background:#f5f4ef}

.toolbar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;padding:6px 10px;
  background:rgba(255,255,255,.97);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);
  border-bottom:1px solid #e0e0e0;
  flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none;
  z-index:100;flex-shrink:0;touch-action:pan-x;
}
.toolbar::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.tb-group{display:flex;gap:2px;align-items:center;flex-shrink:0}
.tb-sep{width:1px;height:28px;background:#d1d1d6;margin:0 4px;flex-shrink:0}
.tb-btn{border:none;background:transparent;border-radius:10px;width:36px;height:36px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;font-size:17px;transition:background .12s;flex-shrink:0;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;color:#1c1c1e;touch-action:manipulation}
.tb-btn:hover{background:#f0f0f0}
.tb-btn:active{background:#e8e8e8}
.tb-btn.active{background:#ede9fe;color:#7c3aed}
.tb-btn.danger.has-selection{color:#ff3b30;background:#fff0f0}
.tb-back{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;color:#7c3aed;background:none;border:none;cursor:pointer;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:8px;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;touch-action:manipulation}
.tb-back:hover{background:#ede9fe}
.board-title-input{flex:1;min-width:60px;border:none;background:transparent;font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#1c1c1e;text-align:center;outline:none;touch-action:auto;user-select:text;-webkit-user-select:text}
.color-dots{display:flex;gap:4px;align-items:center}
.color-dot{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s;flex-shrink:0;touch-action:manipulation}
.color-dot.active{transform:scale(1.25);border-color:#333}
.stroke-slider{width:60px;accent-color:#7c3aed;flex-shrink:0;touch-action:none}
.portrait-toggle{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;background:#7c3aed;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:8px;padding:5px 10px;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;touch-action:manipulation}

.editor-body{flex:1;overflow:hidden;display:flex;min-height:0}
.editor-body.portrait{flex-direction:column}
.editor-body.landscape{flex-direction:row}

/* ===== サイドパネル ===== */
.side-panel{background:#fff;flex-shrink:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;border-color:#e0e0e0;border-style:solid;border-width:0}
.editor-body.portrait .side-panel{border-bottom-width:1px;width:100%}
.editor-body.landscape .side-panel{border-right-width:1px;height:100%}
.side-panel-inner{flex:1;overflow-y:auto;overflow-x:hidden;padding:16px;touch-action:pan-y;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;min-height:0}

.landscape-toggle{position:absolute;left:0;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);z-index:110;background:#7c3aed;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;width:18px;height:56px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;touch-action:manipulation;writing-mode:vertical-rl;font-size:11px;font-weight:700}

/* ===== プロパティ ===== */
.prop-board-title{width:100%;font-size:20px;font-weight:700;color:#1c1c1e;border:none;border-bottom:2px solid #ebebef;outline:none;background:transparent;padding:0 0 6px;margin-bottom:14px;touch-action:auto;user-select:text;-webkit-user-select:text}
.prop-section-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#8e8e93;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:8px}
.prop-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-bottom:10px}
.prop-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:6px 8px;border-radius:8px;background:#f9f9fb;border:1px solid #ebebef}
.prop-name{font-size:12px;color:#636366;min-width:60px;flex-shrink:0;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.prop-value-wrap{flex:1;min-width:0}
.prop-input{width:100%;border:none;background:transparent;font-size:13px;color:#1c1c1e;outline:none;touch-action:auto;user-select:text;-webkit-user-select:text}
.prop-select{width:100%;border:none;background:transparent;font-size:13px;color:#1c1c1e;outline:none;cursor:pointer}
.prop-del-btn{background:none;border:none;color:#c7c7cc;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;padding:2px 4px;border-radius:4px;line-height:1}
.prop-del-btn:hover{color:#ff3b30;background:#fff0f0}
.prop-options-edit{font-size:11px;color:#7c3aed;cursor:pointer;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;background:#ede9fe;border:none;flex-shrink:0}
.btn-add-prop{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:none;border:1.5px dashed #c7c7cc;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 12px;font-size:13px;color:#8e8e93;cursor:pointer;width:100%;touch-action:manipulation;margin-top:2px}
.btn-add-prop:hover{border-color:#7c3aed;color:#7c3aed;background:#faf8ff}

/* チェックリスト */
.checklist-container{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;margin-top:2px}
.checklist-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:4px 2px;border-radius:6px}
.checklist-item:hover{background:#f5f0ff}
.checklist-item input[type=checkbox]{width:16px;height:16px;accent-color:#7c3aed;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}
.checklist-item-text{flex:1;font-size:13px;color:#1c1c1e;border:none;background:transparent;outline:none;touch-action:auto;user-select:text;-webkit-user-select:text}
.checklist-item-text.done{text-decoration:line-through;color:#8e8e93}
.checklist-item-del{background:none;border:none;color:#c7c7cc;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;padding:2px;border-radius:4px;flex-shrink:0;opacity:0}
.checklist-item:hover .checklist-item-del{opacity:1}
.checklist-item-del:hover{color:#ff3b30}
.btn-add-checklist-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:none;border:none;color:#8e8e93;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 2px;touch-action:manipulation}
.btn-add-checklist-item:hover{color:#7c3aed}
.checklist-progress{font-size:11px;color:#8e8e93;margin-left:2px}

/* プロパティ型ポップアップ */
.prop-type-popup{position:fixed;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.2);padding:8px;z-index:800;border:1px solid #e0e0e0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:150px}
.prop-type-popup.hidden{display:none}
.prop-type-opt{padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:#1c1c1e}
.prop-type-opt:hover{background:#f5f0ff;color:#7c3aed}

/* ===== Markdownエディタ ===== */
.md-section{border-top:1px solid #ebebef;padding:14px 0 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}
.md-toolbar-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:6px}
.md-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#8e8e93;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.md-mode-btns{display:flex;gap:4px}
.md-mode-btn{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:6px;border:1.5px solid #e0e0e0;background:#fff;color:#636366;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}
.md-mode-btn.active{background:#7c3aed;border-color:#7c3aed;color:#fff}

/* リッチエディタ（ブロック式） */
.rich-editor{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-height:60px;cursor:text}
.block{
  display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:6px;
  padding:3px 2px;border-radius:6px;
  position:relative;
}
.block:hover .block-handle{opacity:.4}
.block-handle{width:16px;flex-shrink:0;text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:#c7c7cc;cursor:grab;margin-top:4px;opacity:0;touch-action:manipulation;user-select:none}
.block-content{
  flex:1;min-width:0;outline:none;
  font-size:14px;color:#1c1c1e;line-height:1.6;
  border:none;background:transparent;
  touch-action:auto;user-select:text;-webkit-user-select:text;
  white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;
}
/* ブロック種別スタイル */
.block[data-type="h1"] .block-content{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;color:#1c1c1e}
.block[data-type="h2"] .block-content{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:#1c1c1e}
.block[data-type="h3"] .block-content{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#1c1c1e}
.block[data-type="quote"] .block-content{color:#636366;font-style:italic}
.block[data-type="quote"]{border-left:3px solid #7c3aed;padding-left:8px}
.block[data-type="code"] .block-content{font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-size:12px;background:#f0f0f5;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;color:#c7254e}
.block[data-type="hr"]{border-top:1px solid #e0e0e0;padding:0;margin:4px 0;pointer-events:none}
.block[data-type="bullet"] .block-bullet{color:#7c3aed;font-size:16px;margin-top:2px;flex-shrink:0}
.block[data-type="todo"] .block-check{width:16px;height:16px;accent-color:#7c3aed;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:4px}
.block[data-type="todo"].done .block-content{text-decoration:line-through;color:#8e8e93}

/* ブロック追加ボタン */
.block-add-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;margin-top:4px}
.btn-add-block{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:none;border:none;color:#c7c7cc;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 2px;touch-action:manipulation}
.btn-add-block:hover{color:#7c3aed}

/* ブロック型選択ポップアップ */
.block-type-popup{
  position:fixed;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;
  box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
  padding:8px;z-index:800;border:1px solid #e0e0e0;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:170px
}
.block-type-popup.hidden{display:none}
.block-type-opt{padding:7px 12px;border-radius:7px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:#1c1c1e}
.block-type-opt:hover{background:#f5f0ff;color:#7c3aed}
.block-type-shortcut{font-size:10px;color:#c7c7cc;margin-left:auto}

/* Rawテキストエリア */
.md-raw-textarea{
  width:100%;min-height:180px;border:1.5px solid #7c3aed;border-radius:8px;
  padding:10px 12px;font-size:13px;font-family:'Courier New',Courier,monospace;
  outline:none;resize:vertical;color:#1c1c1e;background:#faf8ff;
  touch-action:auto;user-select:text;-webkit-user-select:text;line-height:1.6;
}

/* ===== Canvas ===== */
.canvas-wrap{flex:1;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#f5f4ef;min-width:0;min-height:0}
#mainCanvas{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;touch-action:none;cursor:crosshair}
#mainCanvas.select-mode{cursor:default}

/* 図形ポップアップ */
.shape-popup{position:absolute;top:8px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#2c2c2e;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.45);padding:10px;display:flex;gap:8px;z-index:200;border:1px solid #3a3a3c}
.shape-popup.hidden{display:none}
.shape-opt{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:12px;background:#1c1c1e;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:2px solid #3a3a3c;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s;touch-action:manipulation}
.shape-opt.selected,.shape-opt:hover{background:#2d1e6b;border-color:#7c3aed}

/* スタイルパネル */
.style-panel{position:absolute;top:8px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#fff;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.2);padding:16px;z-index:200;border:1px solid #e0e0e0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;min-width:300px;max-width:94vw;touch-action:auto;max-height:80vh;overflow-y:auto}
.style-panel.hidden{display:none}
.sp-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;border-bottom:1px solid #e0e0e0;padding-bottom:8px}
.sp-tab{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:8px;border:none;background:none;cursor:pointer;color:#636366;touch-action:manipulation}
.sp-tab.active{background:#ede9fe;color:#7c3aed}
.sp-body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.sp-body.hidden{display:none}
.sp-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.sp-label{font-size:12px;color:#636366;width:70px;flex-shrink:0}
.sp-colors{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sp-dot{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s;flex-shrink:0;touch-action:manipulation}
.sp-dot.active,.sp-dot:hover{transform:scale(1.2);border-color:#333}
.sp-slider{flex:1;accent-color:#7c3aed;touch-action:none}
.sp-val{font-size:11px;color:#636366;width:36px;text-align:right;flex-shrink:0}
.sp-select{flex:1;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:8px;border:1.5px solid #d1d1d6;font-size:13px;outline:none;color:#1c1c1e;background:#fff;touch-action:auto}
.sp-close{align-self:flex-end;background:none;border:none;color:#7c3aed;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:6px;touch-action:manipulation}
.sp-close:hover{background:#ede9fe}

/* 選択ボックス */
.sel-box{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;z-index:20;border:2px solid #2563eb;border-radius:3px}
.sel-handle{position:absolute;width:22px;height:22px;background:#fff;border:2.5px solid #2563eb;border-radius:6px;pointer-events:all;z-index:21;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);touch-action:none;cursor:pointer}
.float-textarea{position:absolute;z-index:50;resize:none;outline:none;border:none;overflow:hidden;background:transparent;line-height:1.5;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:8px;opacity:0.01;touch-action:auto;user-select:text;-webkit-user-select:text}
.mode-badge{position:absolute;bottom:12px;right:12px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);color:#fff;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:12px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;pointer-events:none;z-index:50}

/* Toast & Loading */
.toast{position:fixed;bottom:20px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(80px);padding:10px 22px;border-radius:20px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;transition:transform .3s ease;z-index:9999;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap}
.toast.show{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
.toast.success{background:rgba(52,199,89,.95);color:#fff}
.toast.error{background:rgba(255,69,58,.95);color:#fff}
.toast.info{background:rgba(0,122,255,.95);color:#fff}
.loading-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:9999;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.loading-overlay.hidden{display:none}
.loading-spinner{width:48px;height:48px;border:4px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-top-color:#a78bfa;border-radius:50%;animation:spin .8s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}

/* モーダル */
.modal-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:900;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.modal-overlay.hidden{display:none}
.modal-card{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:24px;width:min(380px,90vw);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.modal-card h3{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:#1c1c1e}
.modal-input{width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border:1.5px solid #d1d1d6;border-radius:8px;font-size:14px;color:#1c1c1e;outline:none;touch-action:auto;user-select:text;-webkit-user-select:text}
.modal-input:focus{border-color:#7c3aed}
.modal-btns{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end}
.modal-btn{padding:8px 18px;border-radius:8px;border:none;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
.modal-btn.cancel{background:#f0f0f5;color:#636366}
.modal-btn.ok{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7c3aed,#2563eb);color:#fff}
.options-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;max-height:180px;overflow-y:auto}

// ---- Base64 ----
function encodeBase64(str){
  var bytes=new TextEncoder().encode(str),bin='';
  bytes.forEach(function(b){bin+=String.fromCharCode(b);});
  return btoa(bin);
}
function decodeBase64(b64){
  var bin=atob(b64.replace(/[\n\r]/g,'')),bytes=new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for(var i=0;i<bin.length;i++)bytes[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);
  return new TextDecoder().decode(bytes);
}

// ---- URLハッシュ ----
var cfg={};
function parseHash(){
  var map={},hash=location.hash.slice(1);if(!hash)return map;
  hash.split('&').forEach(function(pair){var idx=pair.indexOf('=');if(idx<0)return;map[pair.slice(0,idx)]=decodeURIComponent(pair.slice(idx+1));});
  return map;
}
function buildHashUrl(o,r,t){return location.href.split('#')[0]+'#owner='+encodeURIComponent(o)+'&repo='+encodeURIComponent(r)+'&token='+encodeURIComponent(t);}
function loadConfig(){var p=parseHash();if(p.owner&&p.repo&&p.token){cfg=p;return true;}return false;}

// ---- GitHub API ----
var GH='https://api.github.com',DATA_PATH='data/boards.json',fileSHA=null;
function ghHeaders(){return{'Authorization':'Bearer '+cfg.token,'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json','X-GitHub-Api-Version':'2022-11-28'};}
function ghGetFile(path){
  return fetch(GH+'/repos/'+cfg.owner+'/'+cfg.repo+'/contents/'+path,{headers:ghHeaders(),cache:'no-store'})
  .then(function(res){if(res.status===404)return null;if(!res.ok)throw new Error('GET '+res.status);return res.json();});
}
function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}
async function ghPutFile(path,obj,msg){
  var b64=encodeBase64(JSON.stringify(obj,null,2));
  for(var attempt=1;attempt<=3;attempt++){
    try{var cur=await ghGetFile(path);fileSHA=cur?cur.sha:null;}catch(_){}
    var body={message:msg,content:b64,committer:{name:'FreePad',email:'freepad@app.local'}};
    if(fileSHA)body.sha=fileSHA;
    var res=await fetch(GH+'/repos/'+cfg.owner+'/'+cfg.repo+'/contents/'+path,
      {method:'PUT',headers:Object.assign({},ghHeaders(),{'Content-Type':'application/json'}),body:JSON.stringify(body)});
    if(res.ok){var data=await res.json();fileSHA=data.content.sha;return data;}
    var eb=await res.json().catch(function(){return{};});
    if(res.status===409){await sleep(700*attempt);continue;}
    throw new Error(eb.message||'PUT '+res.status);
  }
  throw new Error('保存に3回失敗しました。再読み込みして再試行してください。');
}
async function loadBoardsFromGitHub(){
  setSyncStatus('loading','同期中...');
  try{var f=await ghGetFile(DATA_PATH);if(!f){fileSHA=null;boards=[];}else{fileSHA=f.sha;boards=JSON.parse(decodeBase64(f.content));}setSyncStatus('ok','同期済み');}
  catch(e){setSyncStatus('error','エラー');showToast('⚠️ 読み込み失敗: '+e.message,'error');}
}
async function saveBoardsToGitHub(){
  setSyncStatus('loading','保存中...');
  try{await ghPutFile(DATA_PATH,boards,'FreePad '+new Date().toISOString());setSyncStatus('ok','同期済み');return true;}
  catch(e){setSyncStatus('error','エラー');showToast('⚠️ '+e.message,'error');return false;}
}

// ---- ブロック⇔Markdown変換 ----
function blocksToMarkdown(blocks){
  return (blocks||[]).map(function(b){
    switch(b.type){
      case 'h1':    return '# '+b.text;
      case 'h2':    return '## '+b.text;
      case 'h3':    return '### '+b.text;
      case 'bullet':return '- '+b.text;
      case 'todo':  return (b.checked?'- [x] ':'- [ ] ')+b.text;
      case 'quote': return '> '+b.text;
      case 'code':  return '```\n'+b.text+'\n```';
      case 'hr':    return '---';
      default:      return b.text||'';
    }
  }).join('\n');
}

function markdownToBlocks(md){
  if(!md||!md.trim())return[];
  var lines=md.split('\n');
  var blocks=[];
  var inCode=false,codeLines=[];
  lines.forEach(function(line){
    if(line.startsWith('```')){
      if(inCode){blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'code',text:codeLines.join('\n')});codeLines=[];inCode=false;}
      else inCode=true;
      return;
    }
    if(inCode){codeLines.push(line);return;}
    if(line==='---'||line==='***'||line==='___'){blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'hr',text:''});return;}
    if(/^# /.test(line)){blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'h1',text:line.slice(2)});return;}
    if(/^## /.test(line)){blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'h2',text:line.slice(3)});return;}
    if(/^### /.test(line)){blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'h3',text:line.slice(4)});return;}
    if(/^- \[x\] /i.test(line)){blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'todo',text:line.slice(6),checked:true});return;}
    if(/^- \[ \] /.test(line)){blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'todo',text:line.slice(6),checked:false});return;}
    if(/^- /.test(line)){blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'bullet',text:line.slice(2)});return;}
    if(/^> /.test(line)){blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'quote',text:line.slice(2)});return;}
    blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'p',text:line});
  });
  if(inCode&&codeLines.length)blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'code',text:codeLines.join('\n')});
  return blocks.filter(function(b){return !(b.type==='p'&&b.text==='');});
}

function makeBlockEl(block,idx){
  var div=document.createElement('div');
  div.className='block';div.dataset.id=block.id;div.dataset.type=block.type;

  // 区切り線
  if(block.type==='hr'){
    div.style.cssText='border-top:1.5px solid #e0e0e0;padding:0;margin:6px 0;min-height:1px';
    return div;
  }

  // ドラッグハンドル
  var handle=document.createElement('div');handle.className='block-handle';handle.textContent='⠿';
  handle.draggable=true;
  handle.addEventListener('dragstart',function(e){e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain',block.id);div.style.opacity='.4';});
  handle.addEventListener('dragend',function(){div.style.opacity='1';});
  div.addEventListener('dragover',function(e){e.preventDefault();div.style.background='#f0ebff';});
  div.addEventListener('dragleave',function(){div.style.background='';});
  div.addEventListener('drop',function(e){
    e.preventDefault();div.style.background='';
    var fromId=e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
    var fromIdx=mdBlocks.findIndex(function(b){return b.id===fromId;});
    var toIdx=mdBlocks.findIndex(function(b){return b.id===block.id;});
    if(fromIdx<0||toIdx<0||fromIdx===toIdx)return;
    var moved=mdBlocks.splice(fromIdx,1)[0];
    mdBlocks.splice(toIdx,0,moved);
    renderRichEditor();
  });

  // ToDo チェックボックス
  if(block.type==='todo'){
    var cb=document.createElement('input');
    cb.type='checkbox';cb.className='block-check';cb.checked=!!block.checked;
    cb.addEventListener('change',function(){
      block.checked=cb.checked;
      div.classList.toggle('done',cb.checked);
    });
    if(block.checked)div.classList.add('done');
    div.appendChild(handle);div.appendChild(cb);
  }else if(block.type==='bullet'){
    var bullet=document.createElement('div');bullet.className='block-bullet';bullet.textContent='•';
    div.appendChild(handle);div.appendChild(bullet);
  }else{
    div.appendChild(handle);
  }

  // コンテンツ（contenteditable）
  var content=document.createElement('div');
  content.className='block-content';
  content.contentEditable='true';
  content.setAttribute('data-placeholder', getPlaceholder(block.type));
  content.spellcheck=false;
  content.autocorrect='off';
  content.autocapitalize='none';
  content.style.setProperty('--ph-color','#c7c7cc');
  // placeholderスタイル
  content.setAttribute('aria-label', getPlaceholder(block.type));

  // テキスト表示（インラインMarkdown装飾）
  content.innerHTML = renderInlineMarkdown(block.text||'');

  content.addEventListener('focus',function(){
    // フォーカス時はプレーンテキストに切り替え（編集しやすくする）
    if(content.dataset.editing)return;
    content.dataset.editing='1';
    content.textContent=block.text||'';
    // カーソルを末尾へ
    var range=document.createRange(),sel=window.getSelection();
    range.selectNodeContents(content);range.collapse(false);
    sel.removeAllRanges();sel.addRange(range);
  });

  content.addEventListener('blur',function(){
    delete content.dataset.editing;
    block.text=content.textContent||'';
    content.innerHTML=renderInlineMarkdown(block.text);
  });

  content.addEventListener('input',function(){
    block.text=content.textContent||'';
    // Markdown記法の自動変換（スペース押下で）
    var text=content.textContent;
    var converted=checkInlineConvert(text,block,idx);
    if(converted){renderRichEditor();setTimeout(function(){focusBlock(converted);},10);}
  });

  content.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(isComposing)return;

    // Enterで新ブロック追加
    if(e.key==='Enter'&&!e.shiftKey){
      e.preventDefault();
      block.text=content.textContent||'';
      var newType=(block.type==='bullet'||block.type==='todo')?block.type:'p';
      // bulletやtodoで空テキストの場合はpに戻す
      if((block.type==='bullet'||block.type==='todo')&&!block.text){
        block.type='p';block.text='';
        renderRichEditor();setTimeout(function(){focusBlock(block.id);},10);return;
      }
      var newBlock={id:genId(),type:newType,text:'',checked:false};
      mdBlocks.splice(idx+1,0,newBlock);
      renderRichEditor();
      setTimeout(function(){focusBlock(newBlock.id);},10);
      return;
    }

    // Backspaceで空ブロック削除
    if(e.key==='Backspace'){
      block.text=content.textContent||'';
      if(!block.text&&mdBlocks.length>1){
        e.preventDefault();
        var prevId=mdBlocks[Math.max(0,idx-1)].id;
        mdBlocks.splice(idx,1);
        renderRichEditor();setTimeout(function(){focusBlock(prevId,true);},10);
        return;
      }
      // 見出しなどをpに戻す
      if(!block.text&&block.type!=='p'){
        e.preventDefault();block.type='p';
        renderRichEditor();setTimeout(function(){focusBlock(block.id);},10);
      }
    }

    // Tab でインデント（bullet のみ）
    if(e.key==='Tab'){
      e.preventDefault();
      // 将来の入れ子対応用にとりあえず無視
    }

    // ↑↓ キーで前後ブロックへ移動
    if(e.key==='ArrowUp'&&idx>0){
      var prev=mdBlocks[idx-1];
      if(getCaretLine(content)===0){e.preventDefault();focusBlock(prev.id,true);}
    }
    if(e.key==='ArrowDown'&&idx<mdBlocks.length-1){
      var next=mdBlocks[idx+1];
      if(getCaretLine(content,true)){ e.preventDefault();focusBlock(next.id);}
    }
  });

  // IME
  content.addEventListener('compositionstart',function(){isComposing=true;});
  content.addEventListener('compositionend',function(){
    isComposing=false;
    block.text=content.textContent||'';
  });

  div.appendChild(content);
  return div;
}

// カーソルが最初/最後の行にいるか
function getCaretLine(el,last){

    return rect.top<elRect.top+4;
  }catch(_){return false;}
}

// 先頭入力でブロック型変換
function checkInlineConvert(text,block,idx){
  var convMap=[
    {prefix:'# ',  type:'h1'},
    {prefix:'## ', type:'h2'},
    {prefix:'### ',type:'h3'},
    {prefix:'- ',  type:'bullet'},
    {prefix:'> ',  type:'quote'},
  ];
  for(var i=0;i<convMap.length;i++){
    if(text===convMap[i].prefix){
      block.type=convMap[i].type;block.text='';return block.id;
    }
  }
  if(text==='---'||text==='***'){
    block.type='hr';block.text='';
    var nb={id:genId(),type:'p',text:''};
    mdBlocks.splice(idx+1,0,nb);
    return nb.id;
  }
  return null;
}

// インラインMarkdown装飾
function renderInlineMarkdown(text){
  if(!text)return '';
  // エスケープ
  var s=text.replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>');
  // **bold**
  s=s.replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g,'<strong>$1</strong>');
  // *italic*
  s=s.replace(/\*(.*?)\*/g,'<em>$1</em>');
  // `code`
  s=s.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g,'<code style="background:#f0f0f5;padding:1px 4px;border-radius:3px;font-size:.9em">$1</code>');
  // ~~strike~~
  s=s.replace(/~~(.*?)~~/g,'<del>$1</del>');
  // [text](url)
  s=s.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g,'<a href="$2" style="color:#7c3aed" target="_blank">$1</a>');
  return s;
}

function redraw(){

function drawGrid(W,H){

}
function drawTextItem(t){

    ctx.strokeStyle=t.borderColor;ctx.lineWidth=bw;ctx.beginPath();roundRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,8);ctx.stroke();
  }

function wrapText(ctx,text,x,y,maxW,lineH){

    var words=line.split(' '),cur='';

function roundRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r){

  ctx.lineTo(x+r,y+h);ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y+h-r,r);

function drawStroke(s){

function drawShape(s,lw){

    case 'arrow':drawArrow(x1,y1,x2,y2,ctx.lineWidth);break;

function drawArrow(x1,y1,x2,y2,lw){

  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x2,y2);
  ctx.lineTo(x2-hl*Math.cos(angle-Math.PI/7),y2-hl*Math.sin(angle-Math.PI/7));
  ctx.lineTo(x2-hl*Math.cos(angle+Math.PI/7),y2-hl*Math.sin(angle+Math.PI/7));

  floatInput.addEventListener('compositionstart',function(){isComposing=true;});
  floatInput.addEventListener('compositionend',function(){isComposing=false;t.text=floatInput.value;autoGrow(t);redraw();updateSelBox();});

  ['pointerdown','pointermove','pointerup','touchstart','touchmove','touchend'].forEach(function(ev){floatInput.addEventListener(ev,function(e){e.stopPropagation();},{passive:true});});

}
function autoGrow(t){if(!floatInput)return;t.h=Math.max(80,(t.text||'').split('\n').length*(t.fontSize||18)*1.6+20);floatInput.style.height=(t.h*scale)+'px';}
function posFloatInput(t){if(!floatInput)return;floatInput.style.left=(t.x*scale+panX)+'px';floatInput.style.top=(t.y*scale+panY)+'px';floatInput.style.width=((t.w||200)*scale)+'px';floatInput.style.height=((t.h||80)*scale)+'px';floatInput.style.fontSize=((t.fontSize||18)*scale)+'px';}

  });
  document.addEventListener('keyup',function(e){shiftDown=e.shiftKey;});

.btn-add-prop{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;background:none;border:1.5px dashed #c7c7cc;border-radius:8px;padding:7px 12px;font-size:13px;color:#8e8e93;cursor:pointer;width:100%;touch-action:manipulation;margin-top:2px}
.btn-add-prop:hover{border-color:#7c3aed;color:#7c3aed;background:#faf8ff}

/* チェックリスト */
.checklist-container{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;margin-top:2px}
.checklist-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;padding:4px 2px;border-radius:6px}
.checklist-item:hover{background:#f5f0ff}
.checklist-item input[type=checkbox]{width:16px;height:16px;accent-color:#7c3aed;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0}
.checklist-item-text{flex:1;font-size:13px;color:#1c1c1e;border:none;background:transparent;outline:none;touch-action:auto;user-select:text;-webkit-user-select:text}
.checklist-item-text.done{text-decoration:line-through;color:#8e8e93}
.checklist-item-del{background:none;border:none;color:#c7c7cc;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;padding:2px;border-radius:4px;flex-shrink:0;opacity:0}
.checklist-item:hover .checklist-item-del{opacity:1}
.checklist-item-del:hover{color:#ff3b30}
.btn-add-checklist-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:none;border:none;color:#8e8e93;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 2px;touch-action:manipulation}
.btn-add-checklist-item:hover{color:#7c3aed}
.checklist-progress{font-size:11px;color:#8e8e93;margin-left:2px}

/* プロパティ型ポップアップ */
.prop-type-popup{position:fixed;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.2);padding:8px;z-index:800;border:1px solid #e0e0e0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:150px}
.prop-type-popup.hidden{display:none}
.prop-type-opt{padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:#1c1c1e}
.prop-type-opt:hover{background:#f5f0ff;color:#7c3aed}

/* ===== Markdownエディタ ===== */
.md-section{border-top:1px solid #ebebef;padding:14px 0 8px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;margin-top:12px}
.md-toolbar-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:6px}
.md-label{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;color:#8e8e93;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.06em}
.md-mode-btns{display:flex;gap:4px}
.md-mode-btn{font-size:11px;font-weight:600;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:6px;border:1.5px solid #e0e0e0;background:#fff;color:#636366;cursor:pointer;touch-action:manipulation}
.md-mode-btn.active{background:#7c3aed;border-color:#7c3aed;color:#fff}

/* リッチエディタ（ブロック式） */
.rich-editor{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-height:60px;cursor:text}
.block{
  display:flex;align-items:flex-start;gap:6px;
  padding:3px 2px;border-radius:6px;
  position:relative;
}
.block:hover .block-handle{opacity:.4}
.block-handle{width:16px;flex-shrink:0;text-align:center;font-size:11px;color:#c7c7cc;cursor:grab;margin-top:4px;opacity:0;touch-action:manipulation;user-select:none}
.block-content{
  flex:1;min-width:0;outline:none;
  font-size:14px;color:#1c1c1e;line-height:1.6;
  border:none;background:transparent;
  touch-action:auto;user-select:text;-webkit-user-select:text;
  white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-word;
}
/* ブロック種別スタイル */
.block[data-type="h1"] .block-content{font-size:22px;font-weight:700;color:#1c1c1e}
.block[data-type="h2"] .block-content{font-size:18px;font-weight:700;color:#1c1c1e}
.block[data-type="h3"] .block-content{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;color:#1c1c1e}
.block[data-type="quote"] .block-content{color:#636366;font-style:italic}
.block[data-type="quote"]{border-left:3px solid #7c3aed;padding-left:8px}
.block[data-type="code"] .block-content{font-family:'Courier New',monospace;font-size:12px;background:#f0f0f5;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;color:#c7254e}
.block[data-type="hr"]{border-top:1px solid #e0e0e0;padding:0;margin:4px 0;pointer-events:none}
.block[data-type="bullet"] .block-bullet{color:#7c3aed;font-size:16px;margin-top:2px;flex-shrink:0}
.block[data-type="todo"] .block-check{width:16px;height:16px;accent-color:#7c3aed;cursor:pointer;flex-shrink:0;margin-top:4px}
.block[data-type="todo"].done .block-content{text-decoration:line-through;color:#8e8e93}

/* ブロック追加ボタン */
.block-add-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;margin-top:4px}
.btn-add-block{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;background:none;border:none;color:#c7c7cc;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 2px;touch-action:manipulation}
.btn-add-block:hover{color:#7c3aed}

/* ブロック型選択ポップアップ */
.block-type-popup{
  position:fixed;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;
  box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
  padding:8px;z-index:800;border:1px solid #e0e0e0;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;min-width:170px
}
.block-type-popup.hidden{display:none}
.block-type-opt{padding:7px 12px;border-radius:7px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;color:#1c1c1e}
.block-type-opt:hover{background:#f5f0ff;color:#7c3aed}
.block-type-shortcut{font-size:10px;color:#c7c7cc;margin-left:auto}

/* Rawテキストエリア */
.md-raw-textarea{
  width:100%;min-height:180px;border:1.5px solid #7c3aed;border-radius:8px;
  padding:10px 12px;font-size:13px;font-family:'Courier New',Courier,monospace;
  outline:none;resize:vertical;color:#1c1c1e;background:#faf8ff;
  touch-action:auto;user-select:text;-webkit-user-select:text;line-height:1.6;
}

/* ===== Canvas ===== */
.canvas-wrap{flex:1;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#f5f4ef;min-width:0;min-height:0}
#mainCanvas{position:absolute;top:0;left:0;touch-action:none;cursor:crosshair}
#mainCanvas.select-mode{cursor:default}

/* 図形ポップアップ */
.shape-popup{position:absolute;top:8px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#2c2c2e;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.45);padding:10px;display:flex;gap:8px;z-index:200;border:1px solid #3a3a3c}
.shape-popup.hidden{display:none}
.shape-opt{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:12px;background:#1c1c1e;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:2px solid #3a3a3c;transition:background .15s,border-color .15s;touch-action:manipulation}
.shape-opt.selected,.shape-opt:hover{background:#2d1e6b;border-color:#7c3aed}

/* スタイルパネル */
.style-panel{position:absolute;top:8px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#fff;border-radius:16px;box-shadow:0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,.2);padding:16px;z-index:200;border:1px solid #e0e0e0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;min-width:300px;max-width:94vw;touch-action:auto;max-height:80vh;overflow-y:auto}
.style-panel.hidden{display:none}
.sp-tabs{display:flex;gap:6px;border-bottom:1px solid #e0e0e0;padding-bottom:8px}
.sp-tab{font-size:13px;font-weight:600;padding:5px 12px;border-radius:8px;border:none;background:none;cursor:pointer;color:#636366;touch-action:manipulation}
.sp-tab.active{background:#ede9fe;color:#7c3aed}
.sp-body{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
.sp-body.hidden{display:none}
.sp-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.sp-label{font-size:12px;color:#636366;width:70px;flex-shrink:0}
.sp-colors{display:flex;gap:4px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sp-dot{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;border:3px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .12s;flex-shrink:0;touch-action:manipulation}
.sp-dot.active,.sp-dot:hover{transform:scale(1.2);border-color:#333}
.sp-slider{flex:1;accent-color:#7c3aed;touch-action:none}
.sp-val{font-size:11px;color:#636366;width:36px;text-align:right;flex-shrink:0}
.sp-select{flex:1;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:8px;border:1.5px solid #d1d1d6;font-size:13px;outline:none;color:#1c1c1e;background:#fff;touch-action:auto}
.sp-close{align-self:flex-end;background:none;border:none;color:#7c3aed;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:6px;touch-action:manipulation}
.sp-close:hover{background:#ede9fe}

/* 選択ボックス */
.sel-box{position:absolute;pointer-events:none;z-index:20;border:2px solid #2563eb;border-radius:3px}
.sel-handle{position:absolute;width:22px;height:22px;background:#fff;border:2.5px solid #2563eb;border-radius:6px;pointer-events:all;z-index:21;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);touch-action:none;cursor:pointer}
.float-textarea{position:absolute;z-index:50;resize:none;outline:none;border:none;overflow:hidden;background:transparent;line-height:1.5;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:8px;opacity:0.01;touch-action:auto;user-select:text;-webkit-user-select:text}
.mode-badge{position:absolute;bottom:12px;right:12px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);color:#fff;padding:4px 12px;border-radius:12px;font-size:11px;font-weight:600;pointer-events:none;z-index:50}

/* Toast & Loading */
.toast{position:fixed;bottom:20px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(80px);padding:10px 22px;border-radius:20px;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;transition:transform .3s ease;z-index:9999;pointer-events:none;white-space:nowrap}
.toast.show{transform:translateX(-50%) translateY(0)}
.toast.success{background:rgba(52,199,89,.95);color:#fff}
.toast.error{background:rgba(255,69,58,.95);color:#fff}
.toast.info{background:rgba(0,122,255,.95);color:#fff}
.loading-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.5);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:9999;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.loading-overlay.hidden{display:none}
.loading-spinner{width:48px;height:48px;border:4px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-top-color:#a78bfa;border-radius:50%;animation:spin .8s linear infinite}
@keyframes spin{to{transform:rotate(360deg)}}

/* モーダル */
.modal-overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.4);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:900;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}
.modal-overlay.hidden{display:none}
.modal-card{background:#fff;border-radius:16px;padding:24px;width:min(380px,90vw);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:14px;box-shadow:0 12px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.modal-card h3{font-size:16px;font-weight:700;color:#1c1c1e}
.modal-input{width:100%;padding:10px 12px;border:1.5px solid #d1d1d6;border-radius:8px;font-size:14px;color:#1c1c1e;outline:none;touch-action:auto;user-select:text;-webkit-user-select:text}
.modal-input:focus{border-color:#7c3aed}
.modal-btns{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end}
.modal-btn{padding:8px 18px;border-radius:8px;border:none;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer}
.modal-btn.cancel{background:#f0f0f5;color:#636366}
.modal-btn.ok{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#7c3aed,#2563eb);color:#fff}
.options-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;max-height:180px;overflow-y:auto}
.option-row{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center}
.option-row input{flex:1;padding:7px 10px;border:1.5px solid #d1d1d6;border-radius:7px;font-size:13px;color:#1c1c1e;outline:none;touch-action:auto;user-select:text;-webkit-user-select:text}
.option-row input:focus{border-color:#7c3aed}
.option-del{background:#fff0f0;border:none;color:#ff3b30;border-radius:6px;width:28px;height:28px;cursor:pointer;font-size:14px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.btn-add-option{background:none;border:1.5px dashed #c7c7cc;border-radius:7px;padding:6px;font-size:13px;color:#8e8e93;cursor:pointer;width:100%}
.btn-add-option:hover{border-color:#7c3aed;color:#7c3aed}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- SETUP -->
<div id="setupScreen" class="screen hidden">
  <div class="setup-card">
    <h2>✦ FreePad 初期設定</h2>
    <p>設定後に表示されるURLをブックマーク登録してください。</p>
    <div>
      <label><span class="step-badge">1</span>GitHubユーザー名</label>
      <input class="setup-input" id="cfgOwner" placeholder="例: your-username" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" autocorrect="off" autocapitalize="none">
    </div>
    <div>
      <label><span class="step-badge">2</span>データ用リポジトリ名</label>
      <input class="setup-input" id="cfgRepo" placeholder="例: freepad-data" autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false" autocorrect="off" autocapitalize="none">
    </div>
    <div>
      <label><span class="step-badge">3</span>Personal Access Token</label>
      <input class="setup-input" id="cfgToken" type="password" placeholder="github_pat_..." autocomplete="off" spellcheck="false">
    </div>
    <div class="setup-error" id="setupError"></div>
    <button class="btn-primary" onclick="setupSave()">接続して確認 →</button>
    <div class="url-box" id="urlBox"><strong>📌 このURLをブックマーク登録してください</strong><span id="urlText"></span></div>
    <button class="btn-copy" id="btnCopy" onclick="copyUrl()">📋 URLをコピー</button>
    <button class="btn-primary" id="btnGo" style="display:none" onclick="goToApp()">アプリを開く →</button>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- HOME -->
<div id="homeScreen" class="screen hidden">
  <div class="home-header">
    <h1>✦ FreePad</h1>
    <div class="header-actions">
      <div class="sync-status"><div class="sync-dot" id="syncDot"></div><span id="syncLabel">同期済み</span></div>
      <button class="btn-settings" onclick="showSetup()">⚙️</button>
      <button class="btn-new" onclick="newBoard()">＋ 新しいボード</button>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="boards-grid" id="boardsGrid"></div>
</div>

<!-- EDITOR -->
<div id="editorScreen" class="screen hidden">
  <div class="toolbar" id="toolbar">
    <button class="tb-back" onclick="goHome()">← 戻る</button>
    <input class="board-title-input" id="boardTitle" placeholder="ボード名">
    <div class="tb-sep"></div>
    <div class="tb-group">
      <button class="tb-btn active" id="toolPen" onclick="setTool('pen')" title="ペン(P)">
        <svg width="19" height="19" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M12 20h9"/><path d="M16.5 3.5a2.121 2.121 0 013 3L7 19l-4 1 1-4L16.5 3.5z"/></svg>
      </button>
      <button class="tb-btn" id="toolText" onclick="setTool('text')" title="テキスト(T)">
        <svg width="19" height="19" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><polyline points="4 7 4 4 20 4 20 7"/><line x1="9" y1="20" x2="15" y2="20"/><line x1="12" y1="4" x2="12" y2="20"/></svg>
      </button>
      <button class="tb-btn" id="toolShape" onclick="toggleShapePopup()" title="図形">
        <svg width="19" height="19" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><rect x="3" y="3" width="18" height="18" rx="2"/></svg>
      </button>
      <button class="tb-btn" id="toolSelect" onclick="setTool('select')" title="選択(S)">
        <svg width="19" height="19" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M5 3l14 9-7 1-3 7z"/></svg>
      </button>
    </div>
    <div class="tb-sep"></div>
    <div class="tb-group color-dots" id="colorPicker"></div>
    <div class="tb-sep"></div>
    <input type="range" class="stroke-slider" id="strokeSize" min="1" max="30" value="4">
    <div class="tb-sep"></div>
    <div class="tb-group">
      <button class="tb-btn" onclick="toggleStylePanel()" title="スタイル">🎨</button>
      <button class="tb-btn danger" id="btnDeleteObj" onclick="deleteSelected()" title="削除">
        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><polyline points="3 6 5 6 21 6"/><path d="M19 6l-1 14H6L5 6"/><path d="M10 11v6M14 11v6"/><path d="M9 6V4h6v2"/></svg>
      </button>
      <button class="tb-btn" onclick="undo()" title="Undo">
        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M3 7v6h6"/><path d="M3 13C4.3 7.2 9.7 3 16 3a9 9 0 110 18 9.3 9.3 0 01-7.5-3.8"/></svg>
      </button>
      <button class="tb-btn" onclick="redo()" title="Redo">
        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M21 7v6h-6"/><path d="M21 13c-1.3-5.8-6.7-10-13-10a9 9 0 100 18 9.3 9.3 0 007.5-3.8"/></svg>
      </button>
      <button class="tb-btn" onclick="saveBoard(true)" title="保存">
        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M19 21H5a2 2 0 01-2-2V5a2 2 0 012-2h11l5 5v11a2 2 0 01-2 2z"/><polyline points="17 21 17 13 7 13 7 21"/><polyline points="7 3 7 8 15 8"/></svg>
      </button>
      <button class="tb-btn" onclick="clearBoard()" title="全消去">
        <svg width="18" height="18" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><path d="M20 20H7L3 16l11-11 6 6-1.5 1.5"/><path d="M6 11l7 7"/></svg>
      </button>
      <button class="portrait-toggle" id="portraitToggle" onclick="togglePanel()" style="display:none">
        📋 <span id="ptIcon">▲</span>
      </button>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="editor-body portrait" id="editorBody">

    <!-- サイドパネル -->
    <div class="side-panel" id="sidePanel">
      <div class="side-panel-inner" id="sidePanelInner">

        <input class="prop-board-title" id="propBoardTitle" placeholder="ボードタイトル">

        <div class="prop-section-label">プロパティ</div>
        <div class="prop-list" id="propList"></div>
        <button class="btn-add-prop" id="btnAddProp" onclick="showPropTypePopup(event)">＋ プロパティを追加</button>

        <!-- Markdownエリア -->
        <div class="md-section">
          <div class="md-toolbar-row">
            <span class="md-label">📝 メモ</span>
            <div class="md-mode-btns">
              <button class="md-mode-btn active" id="mdBtnRich" onclick="setMdMode('rich')">リッチ</button>
              <button class="md-mode-btn"        id="mdBtnRaw"  onclick="setMdMode('raw')">Markdown</button>
            </div>
          </div>
          <!-- リッチエディタ -->
          <div class="rich-editor" id="richEditor"></div>
          <div class="block-add-row">
            <button class="btn-add-block" id="btnAddBlock" onclick="showBlockTypePopup(event)">＋ ブロックを追加</button>
          </div>
          <!-- Raw テキストエリア -->
          <textarea class="md-raw-textarea" id="mdRawTextarea" style="display:none"
            placeholder="## 見出し
- リスト
**太字** *斜体*

Markdownをそのまま入力できます"></textarea>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- 横長トグル -->
    <button class="landscape-toggle" id="landscapeToggle" onclick="togglePanel()" style="display:none">
      <span id="lsIcon">◀</span>
    </button>

    <!-- Canvas -->
    <div class="canvas-wrap" id="canvasWrap">
      <div class="shape-popup hidden" id="shapePopup">
        <div class="shape-opt" id="shapeOptRect"     onclick="selectShape('rect')"><svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 28 28" fill="none" stroke="#a78bfa" stroke-width="2.5"><rect x="4" y="6" width="20" height="16" rx="2"/></svg></div>
        <div class="shape-opt" id="shapeOptCircle"   onclick="selectShape('circle')"><svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 28 28" fill="none" stroke="#60a5fa" stroke-width="2.5"><ellipse cx="14" cy="14" rx="10" ry="8"/></svg></div>
        <div class="shape-opt" id="shapeOptLine"     onclick="selectShape('line')"><svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 28 28" fill="none" stroke="#34d399" stroke-width="2.5"><line x1="4" y1="24" x2="24" y2="4"/></svg></div>
        <div class="shape-opt" id="shapeOptArrow"    onclick="selectShape('arrow')"><svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 28 28" fill="none" stroke="#f97316" stroke-width="2.5"><line x1="4" y1="24" x2="22" y2="6"/><polyline points="13,6 22,6 22,15"/></svg></div>
        <div class="shape-opt" id="shapeOptTriangle" onclick="selectShape('triangle')"><svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 28 28" fill="none" stroke="#fb7185" stroke-width="2.5"><polygon points="14,4 25,24 3,24"/></svg></div>
      </div>
      <div class="style-panel hidden" id="stylePanel">
        <div class="sp-tabs">
          <button class="sp-tab active" id="spTabText"  onclick="switchSpTab('text')">テキスト</button>
          <button class="sp-tab"        id="spTabShape" onclick="switchSpTab('shape')">図形</button>
        </div>

// ---- Base64 ----
function encodeBase64(str){
  var bytes=new TextEncoder().encode(str),bin='';
  bytes.forEach(function(b){bin+=String.fromCharCode(b);});
  return btoa(bin);
}
function decodeBase64(b64){
  var bin=atob(b64.replace(/[\n\r]/g,'')),bytes=new Uint8Array(bin.length);
  for(var i=0;i<bin.length;i++)bytes[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);
  return new TextDecoder().decode(bytes);
}

// ---- URLハッシュ ----
var cfg={};
function parseHash(){
  var map={},hash=location.hash.slice(1);if(!hash)return map;
  hash.split('&').forEach(function(pair){var idx=pair.indexOf('=');if(idx<0)return;map[pair.slice(0,idx)]=decodeURIComponent(pair.slice(idx+1));});
  return map;
}
function buildHashUrl(o,r,t){return location.href.split('#')[0]+'#owner='+encodeURIComponent(o)+'&repo='+encodeURIComponent(r)+'&token='+encodeURIComponent(t);}
function loadConfig(){var p=parseHash();if(p.owner&&p.repo&&p.token){cfg=p;return true;}return false;}

// ---- GitHub API ----
var GH='https://api.github.com',DATA_PATH='data/boards.json',fileSHA=null;
function ghHeaders(){return{'Authorization':'Bearer '+cfg.token,'Accept':'application/vnd.github+json','X-GitHub-Api-Version':'2022-11-28'};}
function ghGetFile(path){
  return fetch(GH+'/repos/'+cfg.owner+'/'+cfg.repo+'/contents/'+path,{headers:ghHeaders(),cache:'no-store'})
  .then(function(res){if(res.status===404)return null;if(!res.ok)throw new Error('GET '+res.status);return res.json();});
}
function sleep(ms){return new Promise(function(r){setTimeout(r,ms);});}
async function ghPutFile(path,obj,msg){
  var b64=encodeBase64(JSON.stringify(obj,null,2));
  for(var attempt=1;attempt<=3;attempt++){
    try{var cur=await ghGetFile(path);fileSHA=cur?cur.sha:null;}catch(_){}
    var body={message:msg,content:b64,committer:{name:'FreePad',email:'freepad@app.local'}};
    if(fileSHA)body.sha=fileSHA;
    var res=await fetch(GH+'/repos/'+cfg.owner+'/'+cfg.repo+'/contents/'+path,
      {method:'PUT',headers:Object.assign({},ghHeaders(),{'Content-Type':'application/json'}),body:JSON.stringify(body)});
    if(res.ok){var data=await res.json();fileSHA=data.content.sha;return data;}
    var eb=await res.json().catch(function(){return{};});
    if(res.status===409){await sleep(700*attempt);continue;}
    throw new Error(eb.message||'PUT '+res.status);
  }
  throw new Error('保存に3回失敗しました。再読み込みして再試行してください。');
}
async function loadBoardsFromGitHub(){
  setSyncStatus('loading','同期中...');

  catch(e){setSyncStatus('error','エラー');showToast('⚠️ 読み込み失敗: '+e.message,'error');}

    var thumb=document.createElement('canvas');thumb.className='board-thumb';thumb.width=360;thumb.height=270;

    if(b.properties&&b.properties.length){
      b.properties.slice(0,3).forEach(function(p){
        if(p.type==='checklist'){

          var total=(p.items||[]).length;
          if(total>0)propBadges+='<span class="prop-badge">'+esc(p.name)+': '+done+'/'+total+'</span>';
        }else{

          if(v!==''&&v!==null&&v!==undefined){

          }
        }
      });

    grid.appendChild(card);
  });

// ---- ブロック⇔Markdown変換 ----
function blocksToMarkdown(blocks){
  return (blocks||[]).map(function(b){
    switch(b.type){
      case 'h1':    return '# '+b.text;
      case 'h2':    return '## '+b.text;
      case 'h3':    return '### '+b.text;
      case 'bullet':return '- '+b.text;
      case 'todo':  return (b.checked?'- [x] ':'- [ ] ')+b.text;
      case 'quote': return '> '+b.text;
      case 'code':  return '```\n'+b.text+'\n```';
      case 'hr':    return '---';
      default:      return b.text||'';
    }
  }).join('\n');
}

function markdownToBlocks(md){
  if(!md||!md.trim())return[];
  var lines=md.split('\n');
  var blocks=[];
  var inCode=false,codeLines=[];
  lines.forEach(function(line){
    if(line.startsWith('```')){
      if(inCode){blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'code',text:codeLines.join('\n')});codeLines=[];inCode=false;}
      else inCode=true;
      return;
    }
    if(inCode){codeLines.push(line);return;}
    if(line==='---'||line==='***'||line==='___'){blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'hr',text:''});return;}
    if(/^# /.test(line)){blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'h1',text:line.slice(2)});return;}
    if(/^## /.test(line)){blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'h2',text:line.slice(3)});return;}
    if(/^### /.test(line)){blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'h3',text:line.slice(4)});return;}
    if(/^- \[x\] /i.test(line)){blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'todo',text:line.slice(6),checked:true});return;}
    if(/^- \[ \] /.test(line)){blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'todo',text:line.slice(6),checked:false});return;}
    if(/^- /.test(line)){blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'bullet',text:line.slice(2)});return;}
    if(/^> /.test(line)){blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'quote',text:line.slice(2)});return;}
    blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'p',text:line});
  });
  if(inCode&&codeLines.length)blocks.push({id:genId(),type:'code',text:codeLines.join('\n')});
  return blocks.filter(function(b){return !(b.type==='p'&&b.text==='');});
}

function makeBlockEl(block,idx){
  var div=document.createElement('div');
  div.className='block';div.dataset.id=block.id;div.dataset.type=block.type;

  // 区切り線
  if(block.type==='hr'){
    div.style.cssText='border-top:1.5px solid #e0e0e0;padding:0;margin:6px 0;min-height:1px';
    return div;
  }

  // ドラッグハンドル
  var handle=document.createElement('div');handle.className='block-handle';handle.textContent='⠿';
  handle.draggable=true;
  handle.addEventListener('dragstart',function(e){e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain',block.id);div.style.opacity='.4';});
  handle.addEventListener('dragend',function(){div.style.opacity='1';});
  div.addEventListener('dragover',function(e){e.preventDefault();div.style.background='#f0ebff';});
  div.addEventListener('dragleave',function(){div.style.background='';});
  div.addEventListener('drop',function(e){
    e.preventDefault();div.style.background='';
    var fromId=e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
    var fromIdx=mdBlocks.findIndex(function(b){return b.id===fromId;});
    var toIdx=mdBlocks.findIndex(function(b){return b.id===block.id;});
    if(fromIdx<0||toIdx<0||fromIdx===toIdx)return;
    var moved=mdBlocks.splice(fromIdx,1)[0];
    mdBlocks.splice(toIdx,0,moved);
    renderRichEditor();
  });

  // ToDo チェックボックス
  if(block.type==='todo'){
    var cb=document.createElement('input');
    cb.type='checkbox';cb.className='block-check';cb.checked=!!block.checked;
    cb.addEventListener('change',function(){
      block.checked=cb.checked;
      div.classList.toggle('done',cb.checked);
    });
    if(block.checked)div.classList.add('done');
    div.appendChild(handle);div.appendChild(cb);
  }else if(block.type==='bullet'){
    var bullet=document.createElement('div');bullet.className='block-bullet';bullet.textContent='•';
    div.appendChild(handle);div.appendChild(bullet);
  }else{
    div.appendChild(handle);
  }

  // コンテンツ（contenteditable）
  var content=document.createElement('div');
  content.className='block-content';
  content.contentEditable='true';
  content.setAttribute('data-placeholder', getPlaceholder(block.type));
  content.spellcheck=false;
  content.autocorrect='off';
  content.autocapitalize='none';
  content.style.setProperty('--ph-color','#c7c7cc');
  // placeholderスタイル
  content.setAttribute('aria-label', getPlaceholder(block.type));

  // テキスト表示（インラインMarkdown装飾）
  content.innerHTML = renderInlineMarkdown(block.text||'');

  content.addEventListener('focus',function(){
    // フォーカス時はプレーンテキストに切り替え（編集しやすくする）
    if(content.dataset.editing)return;
    content.dataset.editing='1';
    content.textContent=block.text||'';
    // カーソルを末尾へ
    var range=document.createRange(),sel=window.getSelection();
    range.selectNodeContents(content);range.collapse(false);
    sel.removeAllRanges();sel.addRange(range);
  });

  content.addEventListener('blur',function(){
    delete content.dataset.editing;
    block.text=content.textContent||'';
    content.innerHTML=renderInlineMarkdown(block.text);
  });

  content.addEventListener('input',function(){
    block.text=content.textContent||'';
    // Markdown記法の自動変換（スペース押下で）
    var text=content.textContent;
    var converted=checkInlineConvert(text,block,idx);
    if(converted){renderRichEditor();setTimeout(function(){focusBlock(converted);},10);}
  });

  content.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){
    if(isComposing)return;

    // Enterで新ブロック追加
    if(e.key==='Enter'&&!e.shiftKey){
      e.preventDefault();
      block.text=content.textContent||'';
      var newType=(block.type==='bullet'||block.type==='todo')?block.type:'p';
      // bulletやtodoで空テキストの場合はpに戻す
      if((block.type==='bullet'||block.type==='todo')&&!block.text){
        block.type='p';block.text='';
        renderRichEditor();setTimeout(function(){focusBlock(block.id);},10);return;
      }
      var newBlock={id:genId(),type:newType,text:'',checked:false};
      mdBlocks.splice(idx+1,0,newBlock);
      renderRichEditor();
      setTimeout(function(){focusBlock(newBlock.id);},10);
      return;
    }

    // Backspaceで空ブロック削除
    if(e.key==='Backspace'){
      block.text=content.textContent||'';
      if(!block.text&&mdBlocks.length>1){
        e.preventDefault();
        var prevId=mdBlocks[Math.max(0,idx-1)].id;
        mdBlocks.splice(idx,1);
        renderRichEditor();setTimeout(function(){focusBlock(prevId,true);},10);
        return;
      }
      // 見出しなどをpに戻す
      if(!block.text&&block.type!=='p'){
        e.preventDefault();block.type='p';
        renderRichEditor();setTimeout(function(){focusBlock(block.id);},10);
      }
    }

    // Tab でインデント（bullet のみ）
    if(e.key==='Tab'){
      e.preventDefault();
      // 将来の入れ子対応用にとりあえず無視
    }

    // ↑↓ キーで前後ブロックへ移動
    if(e.key==='ArrowUp'&&idx>0){
      var prev=mdBlocks[idx-1];
      if(getCaretLine(content)===0){e.preventDefault();focusBlock(prev.id,true);}
    }
    if(e.key==='ArrowDown'&&idx<mdBlocks.length-1){
      var next=mdBlocks[idx+1];
      if(getCaretLine(content,true)){ e.preventDefault();focusBlock(next.id);}
    }
  });

  // IME
  content.addEventListener('compositionstart',function(){isComposing=true;});
  content.addEventListener('compositionend',function(){
    isComposing=false;
    block.text=content.textContent||'';
  });

  div.appendChild(content);
  return div;
}

function getPlaceholder(type){
  var ph={p:'テキストを入力、または / でブロック追加',h1:'大見出し',h2:'中見出し',h3:'小見出し',
    bullet:'リスト',todo:'ToDo',quote:'引用',code:'コード'};
  return ph[type]||'';
}

// カーソルが最初/最後の行にいるか
function getCaretLine(el,last){
  try{
    var sel=window.getSelection();if(!sel.rangeCount)return false;
    var range=sel.getRangeAt(0).cloneRange();
    var rect=range.getBoundingClientRect();
    var elRect=el.getBoundingClientRect();
    if(last)return rect.bottom>elRect.bottom-4;
    return rect.top<elRect.top+4;
  }catch(_){return false;}
}

function focusBlock(id,atEnd){

  if(!el)return;
  el.focus();

}

// 先頭入力でブロック型変換
function checkInlineConvert(text,block,idx){
  var convMap=[
    {prefix:'# ',  type:'h1'},
    {prefix:'## ', type:'h2'},
    {prefix:'### ',type:'h3'},
    {prefix:'- ',  type:'bullet'},
    {prefix:'> ',  type:'quote'},
  ];
  for(var i=0;i<convMap.length;i++){
    if(text===convMap[i].prefix){
      block.type=convMap[i].type;block.text='';return block.id;
    }
  }
  if(text==='---'||text==='***'){
    block.type='hr';block.text='';
    var nb={id:genId(),type:'p',text:''};
    mdBlocks.splice(idx+1,0,nb);
    return nb.id;
  }
  return null;
}

// インラインMarkdown装飾
function renderInlineMarkdown(text){
  if(!text)return '';
  // エスケープ
  var s=text.replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>');
  // **bold**
  s=s.replace(/\*\*(.*?)\*\*/g,'<strong>$1</strong>');
  // *italic*
  s=s.replace(/\*(.*?)\*/g,'<em>$1</em>');
  // `code`
  s=s.replace(/`([^`]+)`/g,'<code style="background:#f0f0f5;padding:1px 4px;border-radius:3px;font-size:.9em">$1</code>');
  // ~~strike~~
  s=s.replace(/~~(.*?)~~/g,'<del>$1</del>');
  // [text](url)
  s=s.replace(/\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^)]+)\)/g,'<a href="$2" style="color:#7c3aed" target="_blank">$1</a>');
  return s;
}

function resizeCanvas(){
  if(!canvasWrap||!canvas||!ctx)return;
  var rect=canvasWrap.getBoundingClientRect(),dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1;
  canvas.width=rect.width*dpr;canvas.height=rect.height*dpr;
  canvas.style.width=rect.width+'px';canvas.style.height=rect.height+'px';
  ctx.scale(dpr,dpr);redraw();
}
function redraw(){
  if(!ctx||!canvas)return;
  var dpr=window.devicePixelRatio||1,W=canvas.width/dpr,H=canvas.height/dpr;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,W,H);ctx.fillStyle='#f5f4ef';ctx.fillRect(0,0,W,H);
  drawGrid(W,H);
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(panX,panY);ctx.scale(scale,scale);
  textItems.forEach(function(t){drawTextItem(t);});
  strokes.forEach(function(s){drawStroke(s);});
  if(currentStroke)drawStroke(currentStroke);
  if(shapePreview)drawShapePreview();
  ctx.restore();
}
function drawGrid(W,H){
  var sp=24*scale,ox=((panX%sp)+sp)%sp,oy=((panY%sp)+sp)%sp;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(0,0,0,.06)';
  for(var x=ox;x<W;x+=sp)for(var y=oy;y<H;y+=sp){ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(x,y,1.2,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.fill();}
}
function drawTextItem(t){
  var x=t.x,y=t.y,w=t.w||200,h=t.h||80;
  var rgb=hexToRgb(t.bgColor||'#ffffff'),alpha=(t.bgOpacity!=null?t.bgOpacity:90)/100;
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba('+rgb.r+','+rgb.g+','+rgb.b+','+alpha+')';
  ctx.beginPath();roundRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,8);ctx.fill();
  var bw=t.borderWidth!=null?t.borderWidth:2;
  if(bw>0&&t.borderColor&&t.borderColor!=='transparent'){
    ctx.strokeStyle=t.borderColor;ctx.lineWidth=bw;ctx.beginPath();roundRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,8);ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.fillStyle=t.textColor||'#1c1c1e';
  ctx.font=(t.fontSize||18)+'px '+(t.fontFamily||'-apple-system,sans-serif');
  ctx.textBaseline='top';
  wrapText(ctx,t.text||'',x+10,y+8,w-20,(t.fontSize||18)*1.5);
}
function wrapText(ctx,text,x,y,maxW,lineH){
  text.split('\n').forEach(function(line){
    var words=line.split(' '),cur='';
    words.forEach(function(word){
      var test=cur?cur+' '+word:word;
      if(ctx.measureText(test).width>maxW&&cur){ctx.fillText(cur,x,y);cur=word;y+=lineH;}
      else cur=test;
    });
    ctx.fillText(cur,x,y);y+=lineH;
  });
}
function roundRect(ctx,x,y,w,h,r){
  ctx.moveTo(x+r,y);ctx.lineTo(x+w-r,y);ctx.arcTo(x+w,y,x+w,y+r,r);
  ctx.lineTo(x+w,y+h-r);ctx.arcTo(x+w,y+h,x+w-r,y+h,r);
  ctx.lineTo(x+r,y+h);ctx.arcTo(x,y+h,x,y+h-r,r);
  ctx.lineTo(x,y+r);ctx.arcTo(x,y,x+r,y,r);ctx.closePath();
}
function drawStroke(s){
  if(!s.points||s.points.length<2)return;
  ctx.globalCompositeOperation='source-over';
  var lw=(s.screenSize!=null)?s.screenSize/scale:(s.size||4);
  ctx.strokeStyle=s.strokeColor||s.color||'#1c1c1e';
  ctx.lineWidth=lw;ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.lineJoin='round';

    shiftDown=e.shiftKey;if(isComposing)return;
    var editorHidden=document.getElementById('editorScreen').classList.contains('hidden');if(editorHidden)return;
    var tag=document.activeElement?document.activeElement.tagName:'';
    if(tag==='TEXTAREA'||tag==='INPUT'||tag==='SELECT'){if((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)&&e.key==='s'){e.preventDefault();saveBoard(true);}return;}
    // contenteditable は DIV
    if(document.activeElement&&document.activeElement.contentEditable==='true'){if((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)&&e.key==='s'){e.preventDefault();saveBoard(true);}return;}
    if((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)&&e.key==='z'){e.preventDefault();undo();return;}
    if((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)&&(e.key==='y'||(e.shiftKey&&e.key==='Z'))){e.preventDefault();redo();return;}
    if((e.ctrlKey||e.metaKey)&&e.key==='s'){e.preventDefault();saveBoard(true);return;}
    if((e.key==='Delete'||e.key==='Backspace')&&selectedId){e.preventDefault();deleteSelected();return;}
    if(e.key==='p'){setTool('pen');return;}
    if(e.key==='t'){setTool('text');return;}
    if(e.key==='s'&&!e.ctrlKey&&!e.metaKey){setTool('select');return;}
    if(e.key==='Escape'){clearSelection();closeTextEdit();closeShapePopup();closeStylePanel();redraw();}
  });
  document.addEventListener('keyup',function(e){shiftDown=e.shiftKey;});
}

function hexToRgb(hex){if(!hex||hex==='transparent')return{r:255,g:255,b:255};return{r:parseInt(hex.slice(1,3),16),g:parseInt(hex.slice(3,5),16),b:parseInt(hex.slice(5,7),16)};}
function show(id){document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('hidden');}
function hide(id){document.getElementById(id).classList.add('hidden');}
function showLoading(v){document.getElementById('loadingOverlay').classList.toggle('hidden',!v);}
var toastTimer=null;
function showToast(msg,type){type=type||'success';var t=document.getElementById('toast');t.textContent=msg;t.className='toast '+type+' show';if(toastTimer)clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(function(){t.classList.remove('show');},3000);}
function setSyncStatus(state,label){var dot=document.getElementById('syncDot'),lbl=document.getElementById('syncLabel');if(!dot)return;dot.className='sync-dot'+(state==='loading'?' loading':state==='error'?' error':'');if(lbl)lbl.textContent=label;}
